question: What is the theme of the World Economic Forum Annual Meeting, 2019?

options.text: Globalization 4.0: Shaping a Global Architecture in the Age of the Fourth Industrial Revolution
Creating a shared future in a fractured world

solution:
The correct answer is __**Globalization 4.0: Shaping a Global Architecture in the Age of the Fourth Industrial Revolution**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The theme of the World Economic Forum Annual Meeting, 2019, was **Globalization 4.0: Shaping a Global Architecture in the Age of the Fourth Industrial Revolution**.
 
• This theme focused on how the global architecture can be reshaped to address the challenges and opportunities presented by the Fourth Industrial Revolution.
 
• The Fourth Industrial Revolution is characterized by a range of new technologies that are fusing the physical, digital, and biological worlds, impacting all disciplines, economies, and industries.
 
• The meeting aimed to promote dialogue and collaboration among world leaders, policymakers, and business executives to harness these technological advancements for the benefit of society.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The World Economic Forum (WEF) is an international organization for public-private cooperation.
 
• Founded in 1971 by Professor Klaus Schwab, the WEF engages political, business, cultural, and other leaders of society to shape global, regional, and industry agendas.
 
• The Annual Meeting is held in Davos, Switzerland, and brings together around 3,000 participants from around the world.
 
• The WEF's mission is to improve the state of the world by fostering cooperation between the public and private sectors.
